proof_body:
by
  intro G _ a b
  have key : ∀ x y : G, orderOf (y * x * y⁻¹) = orderOf x := by
    intro x y
    have := orderOf_injective (MulAut.conj y).toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj y).injective x
    simpa [MulAut.conj_apply] using this
  refine ⟨key a b, ?_⟩
  have := key (b * a) a
  rw [show a * (b * a) * a⁻¹ = a * b by group] at this
  exact this
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (a b : G), orderOf (b * a * b⁻¹) = orderOf a ∧ orderOf (a * b) = orderOf (b * a)
